Name: Qingfeng - Custom NPC (English)
Author: Solariaze
Description:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/152147618]Originally made by Li Laoliu[/url]﻿﻿
[b]The original mod is in Chinese

NPC Overview[/b]
Birthday - Spring 16th
Location - Top Right of Town, just right above Joja Mart.

[i]This NPC mod has the most personality of any I've translated so far, and it's clear that a lot of work went into creating it.
I hope you enjoy playing with it as much as I enjoyed translating it.[/i]

[b]This Mod Includes:[/b][list]
[*]A new romanceable female NPC.
[*]+500 dialogues for Regular, Spouse, and Festival.
[*]Heart Events: 0, 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, and 9
[*]Seasonal Portraits, as well as Beach outfits.
[*]Complete pre-marriage and post-marriage dialogue and interactions, including an exclusive wedding room.
[*]A new item: Tapioca Bubble Tea
[*]Spouse Portrait.
[/list][b][color=#00ff00]Compatible or Not?[/color][/b][list]
[*][color=#00ff00]SVE, RSV, ES, and other major expansion Mods.[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Wilford NPC[/color]
[*][color=#00ff00]Fishing Pond Facilities[/color]
[/list]
[b]Heart Event Guide[/b]
[color=#f4cccc]Qingfeng's Events are pretty simple to trigger so I won't be making a guide.
Just go to her house every time the specified Heart Event matches with the current heart level.
Try exploring different floors, though most events take place on the 2nd floor.[/color]

Downloads.Description:
Download and install the original mod and replace with the translation files.

UPDATE: Localization update + fixed a lot of mistranslations.
